summary: Temporary danger area EGD799B installed within 2 nautical miles of the Isle of Skye, up to 3,500 ft above sea level, for search and rescue operations.
text:
TEMPORARY DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD799B INSTALLED WI A 2NM RADIUS 
CIRCLE CENTRED ON PSN 5724N 00611W ISLE OF SKYE. SAR OPS ON, NO 
RESTRICTIONS ON FREQ. TO ENSURE SAFETY AND AVOID INTERFERENCE WITH 
CTL AND SAR ACTIVITIES, PILOTS ARE REQ NOT TO FLY IN OR NEAR THE 
AREA WO PERMISSION OF THE EMERG CONTROLLING AUTHORITY VIA TELE 03443 
820800. ACTION MAY BE TAKEN TO IMPOSE RESTRICTIONS OF FLYING 
REGULATIONS UNDER ARTICLE 239 OF THE AIR NAVIGATION ORDER 2016. 
ATC UNITS CLOSE TO THE INCIDENT AREA ARE REQ TO ADVISE ACFT ON 
THEIR FREQ OF THE CONTENTS OF THIS NOTAM.
